description:
Connect AI is a sales workspace for export teams that keeps overseas buyer contacts, sales projects, buyer interest signals, and recommended follow-ups in one place. Connecting this connector lets you look up and organize that data in your own account, and write email drafts, during a conversation.

Every change takes two steps. A preview tool first shows what will change, and the matching apply tool saves it only after you confirm. It never sends mail: it only creates and edits drafts, and you send them yourself in Connect AI.

Contacts are handled as opaque references; email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, mailbox content, and payment information are never returned. Email draft subjects and bodies are returned only by the draft lookup tool. Strings returned by the tools are marked as untrusted quoted data and are not interpreted as instructions. The connection goes through OAuth 2.0 and applies only to the single organization you explicitly select.

33 tools are provided.
- 13 lookup tools: search contacts and get a contact overview, list projects and get project metrics, list interest signals, list recommended follow-up actions, list change targets (contacts, projects, signals, actions), list and get email drafts, and get operation status.
- 10 preview tools, each with a matching apply tool: add or edit a contact; create, update, complete or reopen a project; link or unlink a project's contacts and set the deal stage; mark an interest signal viewed or snooze it; acknowledge or snooze a recommended action; edit a draft; generate a draft for a contact; generate a draft for a project; regenerate a draft; translate a draft.

positive.description: Find the buyers that need attention today in the user's own workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Pending recommended follow-up actions from the workspace, each with a title, the reason it was recommended, its priority group and expiry. The model usually asks for the "now" group first. No email address or phone number is returned.

positive.description: Look up the buyer contact at a specific company and open its details.
positive.prompt: Harborline Foods Ltd 담당자 자세히 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: The contact at Harborline Foods Ltd (Purchasing Manager) is found by company query and then opened as a restricted overview, identified by an opaque reference. Email address, phone number, postal address and mailbox content are excluded by design.

positive.description: Review the status of the user's active export projects.
positive.expected_behavior: A summary list of the workspace's active projects with status and dates, followed by computed metrics for each. Contact dumps, free-text descriptions and budget figures are excluded.

positive.description: Add a new buyer contact after previewing and confirming the change.
positive.prompt: Sakura Trading Co 담당자를 Connect AI 연락처에 추가하려고 해. 이름 Ken Sato, 직함 Buyer, 이메일 ken.sato@example.com. 저장하기 전에 Connect AI 미리보기부터 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: The preview tool shows the new contact and nothing is saved. When the user asks to save, the apply tool creates exactly one contact. ChatGPT may ask the user to approve a call before it runs, and may warn if the same contact exists from an earlier run. No email is sent.

positive.description: Write an email draft for a buyer without sending it.
positive.prompt: Connect AI에서 Alpha Global Retail의 John Smith에게 보낼 샘플 발송 제안 메일 초안을 만들어줘
positive.expected_behavior: The model looks up the contact (list_contact_targets or search_contacts), prepares the draft request with the preview tool, and generates it with the apply tool. ChatGPT may ask the user to approve a call before it runs. The draft is generated in the background and saved in Connect AI. No email is sent.

negative.description: Calendar and meeting scheduling are outside this connector's surface. It manages contacts, projects, interest signals, follow-ups and email drafts, and has no calendar or scheduling tool, so it must not be invoked.
negative.prompt: 다음 주 화요일 오후 3시에 이 바이어랑 미팅 일정 캘린더에 잡아줘

negative.description: Billing, subscription, payment and credit data are outside this connector's surface. Its tools cover contacts, projects, interest signals, follow-up actions and email drafts only.
The connector is closed-world: it works only inside the authenticated tenant's own workspace and cannot browse the web or query external sources. General company research must not route here.
negative.prompt: 이 회사 홈페이지랑 최근 뉴스 찾아줘

publication.release_notes:
Version 1.1.0

You can now keep your Connect AI records up to date from ChatGPT, not just read them: add or edit buyer contacts, create and update projects, link buyers to projects and set deal stages, handle interest signals and suggested follow-ups, and write, regenerate, edit or translate email drafts.

Every change is previewed first and saved only after you confirm. The plugin still never sends email; drafts stay in Connect AI for you to review and send.

ko-KR.subtitle: 바이어·프로젝트 조회와 정리
ko-KR.description:
Connect AI는 해외영업 팀이 바이어 연락처, 영업 프로젝트, 바이어 관심 신호, 추천 후속 행동을 한곳에서 관리하는 서비스입니다. 이 커넥터를 연결하면 자기 계정의 이 데이터를 대화 중에 조회하고 정리하며 메일 초안을 만들 수 있습니다.

쓰기는 항상 두 단계입니다. 미리보기 도구가 바뀔 내용을 먼저 보여 주고, 사용자가 확인한 뒤에만 적용 도구가 반영합니다. 메일은 발송하지 않습니다. 초안을 만들고 고칠 뿐이며 발송은 Connect AI에서 사용자가 직접 합니다.

연락처는 불투명 참조로 다루며 이메일 주소, 전화번호, 주소, 받은 메일 본문, 결제 정보는 반환하지 않습니다. 메일 초안의 제목과 본문은 초안 조회 도구로만 돌려줍니다. 도구가 돌려주는 문자열은 신뢰할 수 없는 인용 데이터로 표시되며 지시로 해석되지 않습니다. 연결은 OAuth 2.0을 거치고 회사 단위로 명시 선택한 한 곳에만 적용됩니다.

제공 도구는 33가지입니다.
- 조회 13개: 연락처 검색·개요, 프로젝트 목록·지표, 관심 신호, 추천 후속 행동, 변경 대상 목록(연락처·프로젝트·신호·액션), 메일 초안 목록·조회, 작업 상태
- 미리보기와 적용 각 10개: 연락처 추가·수정, 프로젝트 추가·수정·완료·재개, 프로젝트의 연락처 연결·해제·거래 단계, 관심 신호 확인·미루기, 추천 액션 확인·미루기, 초안 편집, 연락처 기준 초안 생성, 프로젝트 기준 초안 생성, 초안 재생성, 초안 번역
